items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: The band was called--Carl Fontana and {Hamilton} Joe Wilder, Joe Newman, Gus Johnson, Scott and who else?

ctx.x: How did you get started with the Gibson party?

Dick? I was asked a couple of times that I couldn't make it, of commitments, and I always wanted to. So when I says, "Next year," you know, the last time I was asked, I said, "Next year, I'm going to make damn sure I don't take anything, because I'm going to be ready for this." So when he asked me the next time, I was ready. And I don't know, Dick was pretty tight with me. He was going to be on my day, you know, in Sherman. And because the night before, we played in Corpus Christi, some oil magnates, dons, every…

items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he made a record in Canada. One was a solo piano record and another I think he made with Buddy Tate. And -- [INTERVIEWEE] I have the one with Buddy Tate.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember him in high school?
No, well, he -- I never saw him in Dallas. I didn't meet Buddy Tate in Dallas.
